== Notes ==
* [[Wastrel's Worry]] and [[Wastrel's Demise|Demise]] can be used as [[cover hex]]es and to pressure the target to act prematurely.
* The damage is triggered by successful activation of a spell, but it is applied ''before'' the spell takes effect. Accordingly, targets will take damage if they use a spell to remove Backfire; they can also die by casting a healing spell.
* Similar to [[Chaos Storm]], the [[AI]] in [[normal mode]] will only use this skill on a foe wielding a [[staff]] or [[wand]], even if the potential target is a [[spellcaster]]-primary profession foe with 8 spells on their [[skill bar]]. {{verify|Either Nadya in pre-searing has a specific AI or this rule doesn't work anymore.}}

== Trivia ==
* The figure in this [[skill icon]] is also used in the skill icon for [[Desperation Blow]].
